name: Cybench
description: A framework for evaluating cybersecurity capabilities of LLMs using 40 professional-level Capture the Flag (CTF) challenges spanning cryptography, web security, reverse engineering, exploitation, and forensics. Challenges are sourced from recent CTF competitions. Best models solve tasks that took human expert teams 11 minutes or less. Used by both US and UK AI Safety Institutes for pre-deployment testing.
evaluation_method: task success rate (CTF flag capture); subgoal completion rate
general_score_metric: task success rate (% flags captured); subgoal completion rate
typical_sota_score: ~10–25% (frontier models on full challenges; higher on easy tier challenges)
reputation: ICLR 2025 Oral; used by US AISI and UK AISI for pre-deployment model evaluation; featured in Anthropic's Claude system cards; OWASP's only benchmark for LLM exploit generation; highest real-world impact of any coding benchmark
notes: ICLR 2025 Oral. Used by both US AI Safety Institute and UK AI Safety Institute for pre-deployment safety testing of frontier models. Featured in Anthropic's Claude 3.5 Sonnet system card. OWASP recognizes it as the only standardized LLM exploit generation benchmark. Challenges categorized into easy/medium/hard tiers. Subgoal evaluation provides partial credit for multi-step CTF solutions. Best models solve tasks humans completed in ≤11 minutes.
